response_rows.claim: The question is a pre-emptive reviewer risk, not a supplied verbatim report.
response_rows.boundary: Keep reviewer identity and verbatim wording as a visible placeholder.

response_rows.claim: Without a QPU or physical board, the paper is not an experimental GKP-QEC demonstration.
response_rows.boundary: Use experiment-informed or experiment-facing only when the exact evidence level is stated.

response_rows.claim: The auxiliary atlas contains literature-reported values and explicit not-reported cells.
response_rows.boundary: Literature values are contextual facts, not project measurements or reproductions.

response_rows.claim: AQEC lifetime values are paper-reported physical-system results.
response_rows.boundary: The project-native finite-cutoff replay neither reproduces nor refutes the physical apparatus.

response_rows.claim: Two official-code CPD/analog-MWPM threshold cells were reproduced in their own surface-lattice task signature.
response_rows.boundary: Official-code execution is still numerical reproduction, not device evidence.

response_rows.claim: The AQEC lane executes 432 exact finite-cutoff channels across 144 paired seed clusters and preserves a negative result.
response_rows.boundary: It is nominal-control project-native simulation, not a paper-native reservoir or quantum experiment.

response_rows.claim: The multimode lane is a project-native causal decoder simulation whose strongest-static headroom is zero.
response_rows.boundary: Logical-error simulation does not establish physical lifetime or experimental break-even.

response_rows.claim: A software HIL orchestrator and mock FPGA backend exist.
response_rows.boundary: The P4 wrapper inherits the mock backend; software HIL is not real-board HIL.

response_rows.claim: The legacy real-board backend remains a placeholder with incomplete device event semantics.
response_rows.boundary: Configuration names and readiness documents cannot upgrade it to physical validation.

response_rows.claim: The exact single-mode production top passes 17 formal gates and kills 21 targeted mutants.
response_rows.boundary: Formal proof establishes bounded digital properties, not board timing, power or QPU behavior.

response_rows.claim: The same exact top passes a ten-family one-million-cycle CXXRTL replay with zero mismatch, undefined action and silent overflow.
response_rows.boundary: CXXRTL is executable RTL simulation, not FPGA or quantum-hardware measurement.

response_rows.claim: Three open-source place-and-route seeds meet the 27-MHz contract with whole-harness Fmax 36.794--37.869 MHz.
response_rows.boundary: Resources, Fmax and analytic power remain pre-board estimates and the observability wrapper may dominate timing.

response_rows.claim: A historical UART-wrapper bitstream candidate and post-route estimate exist.
response_rows.boundary: It was never programmed or measured and is not the current exact-top physical qualification.

response_rows.claim: The dedicated physical-board gate is blocked and every measured field is null.
response_rows.boundary: No board correctness, latency, jitter, deadline-miss, resource or power claim is available.

response_rows.claim: No cavity/transmon control chain, physical GKP syndrome dataset or active-displacement experiment is part of the current paper.
response_rows.boundary: The optional Phase 8 tasks remain Todo and cannot be anticipated as results.

response_rows.claim: AQEC and Sivak physical lifetime/break-even evidence remains literature evidence owned by those systems.
response_rows.boundary: It cannot be transferred to the project simulator, decoder, RTL or FPGA board.

response_rows.claim: Deterministic, atomic and fail-closed RTL properties do not prove GKP physical correction.
response_rows.boundary: The hardware contribution is a digital architecture qualification only.

response_rows.claim: The canonical title and abstract avoid experimental-GKP wording and disclose pre-board/null boundaries.
response_rows.boundary: Do not reintroduce device-demonstration language during venue adaptation.

response_rows.claim: Methods and Results label numerical simulation, CXXRTL, formal proof and P&R separately.
response_rows.boundary: No umbrella experimental label may collapse those modalities.

response_rows.claim: Physical FPGA promotion requires non-null board identity, bitstream, cycles, errors, latency/jitter/deadline and power evidence.
response_rows.boundary: P&R estimates or mock HIL cannot fill missing measured fields.

response_rows.claim: Quantum-hardware promotion requires licensed real syndrome data first, then offline decoding, shadow/frame update and authorized feedback.
response_rows.boundary: No real-data metric may be claimed before metadata, labels/tomography and permissions are established.

response_rows.claim: The current contribution is experiment-facing because its interfaces, faults and deadlines are designed for future control-chain integration.
response_rows.boundary: Experiment-facing describes engineering relevance, not completion of an experiment.

response_rows.claim: External validity to a physical GKP platform remains unresolved.
response_rows.boundary: The gap is a limitation and optional Phase 8 route, not a hidden positive result.
